questions.question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

The flood situation in the eastern region of the country remain grim for the fifth day today.
questions.solution: The correct answer is **'remain grim'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'remains grim'** should be used instead of **'remain grim'.** • According to the** 'subject-verb agreement' **rule, the main verb in a sentence should be used on the basis of the **subject**. • In the given sentence,** 'the flood situation' **is the main **subject** that is **singular**. • Hence, **a singular helping verb** should be used. **Correct Sentence:__ ***The flood situation in the eastern region of the country **remains **grim for the fifth day today.* ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहाँ **'remain grim' **के स्थान पर** 'remains grim' **का प्रयोग करना चाहिए। • **'subject-verb agreement' **नियम के अनुसार वाक्य में **main verb** का प्रयोग **subject** के आधार पर करना चाहिए। • दिए गए वाक्य में **'the flood situation'** मुख्य **subject** है जो **singular** है। • इसलिए, एक **singular helping verb **का उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए। 2f:T847, Here the correct answer is **Praise**.

questions.solution:

questions.question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

Though the schools have reopened, children are not go to school and are having online lessons.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'are not go'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'are not going'** should be used instead of** 'are not go'.**
 
• The given sentence is an example of** 'present continuous tense'.**
 
• The **present continuous verb** tense indicates that an action or condition is happening now, frequently, and may continue into the future. 
 
 
• *Example: Mary** is going** to a new school next term.*

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *Though the schools have reopened, children **are not going** to school and are having online lessons.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• यहाँ, **'are not go'** के स्थान पर **'are not going'** का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य** 'present continuous tense'** का उदाहरण है।
 
• **Present continuous** काल इंगित करता है कि कोई क्रिया या स्थिति अभी, बार-बार हो रही है, और भविष्य में भी जारी रह सकती है।
 
 
• *Example: Mary** is going** to a new school next term.*

questions.question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

I was told that we would met at five in the evening but no one has turned up for the meeting so far.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is **'we would met'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the usage of **'met'** is incorrect instead of this we need to use** 'meet'**
 
• According to grammar, whenever we use an auxiliary verb then we need to use a base form with it instead of any other form of the verb. In the given sentence, 'met' is a second form of the verb 'meet'.
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• He said he **would see** his brother tomorrow.
 
 

**So the correct sentence is-** *I was told that we **would meet** at five in the evening but no one has turned up for the meeting so far.*
